messages.subject: [NMOF-news] NMOF 0.34-1 released on CRAN
messages.body_plain:
NMOF 0.34-1 is now available from CRAN and from
http://enricoschumann.net/R/packages/NMOF/index.htm .

There were no user-visible changes. 

(Please see the ChangeLog if you wish to see non-visible changes.)

-- 
Enrico Schumann
Lucerne, Switzerland
http://enricoschumann.net
